summary.name: Discord
summary.one_liner: Discord is a group chat platform for voice, video, text, and game streaming with friends and communities.
use_cases: stream games or shows to friends
watch videos or listen to music together
drop into voice chat without calling
summary.what_it_does: The page describes Discord as a group chat service for voice, video, and text chat, with a focus on gaming and hanging out with friends. Users can customize their profile with custom emoji, stickers, soundboard effects, an avatar, and a custom status. Streaming is advertised as high quality and low latency, for games, shows, or photos. Users can join or leave voice or text chats without calling or inviting people, and can see which friends are online or playing supported games. The page also mentions built-in games, music, and video watching, and says the service works across PC, phone, and console.
notable: Drop in and out of voice or text chats without calling or inviting anyone
Shows friends' current game modes or characters for supported games and lets you join directly
Streaming with high quality and low latency for games, shows, or photos
Switch between devices and manage multiple group chats
caveats: Pricing details are not stated on this page
Some game-joining features only work with supported games
